Maya (ML): Heads-up — plan to start a small canary for the new int4 precision profile on the recommender models today. Proposal: 5% traffic for 30m -> 20% for 1h if stable -> 100% rollout. Need quick checks on perf/quality and infra compatibility.

Pranav: What metrics should we watch specifically? precision/recall? latency? token cost?

Maya (ML): Main signals: offline eval delta on our eval set (quality_score), live CTR/engagement and top-line conversion, p95 latency, error-rate (500s or inference failures), and token/unit cost. Also watch latency tail on cold sessions.

Chris (Infra): gpu compatibility note — int4 kernels land only on runtime v2.14 and above. Can we gate with a flag that targets nodes with runtime >= 2.14? If not, we'll get fallbacks (slower fp16 path).

Olga: Do we have automated quality guardrails? Recommend an auto-rollback if quality_score drops >1.0% absolute or if CTR drops >0.8% relative in canary window. For latency, rollback if p95 increases >25% or p50 increases >40ms.

Maya (ML): Agree on thresholds. Also add an absolute error-rate threshold: if inference_fail_rate >0.2% => immediate rollback.

Pranav: Suggest starting with a narrower audience: 5% but only on US web traffic and non-critical experiments. Less blast radius and easier debugging.

Maya (ML): Good call. Canary scope: country=US, route=/reco/v2, exclude users in active experiments. Rollout flag example (for ops):

`flags.set("quant_profile.recommender", "int4", {"scope": "canary", "pct": 5, "filters": {"country": "US", "route": "/reco/v2"}, "meta": "int4-canary-2026-03-17"})`

Chris (Infra): I'll ensure agent pools with runtime >=2.14 get the flag. I'll also add a scheduler rule to pin canary instances to dedicated capacity so we don't perturb autoscaling.

release-bot: Deployment prechecks passed: kernel-compat=ok, runtime=2.14+, model-quant-profile=int4 available.

Olga: Who's owning the monitoring dashboard and alerts for this canary? We should have a pulse board showing quality_score, CTR, p95 latency, inference_fail_rate, and cost delta.

Maya (ML): I'll own the dashboard and set up alert rules. Plan: critical alert (SEV) if quality drop >1% or fail_rate >0.2% within a 10m window. Warning alert if p95 >25% increase for 15m.

Pranav: One more: add sampling of generated outputs (1% of requests) to S3 with metadata (onnx/quant profile, model version) for offline QA if we need to investigate regressions.

Maya (ML): Done. `sampling.rate=0.01` and payload includes `quant_profile` tag.

Chris (Infra): Rolling out gating and node selection now. I'll add a canary tag to evict older kernels from the canary pool. ETA 10m.

Maya (ML): Sounds good — I'll kick off the flag after infra confirms pool readiness. Will post a short status update at t+30m.

release-bot: Canary started: quant_profile.recommender=int4, scope: US /reco/v2, pct: 5, started_by: Maya (ML), ts: 1750001500

Pranav: Noted. I'll watch dashboard and call out any early quality regressions.

Olga: If we see any spike, do we want an automated rollback or first-get-human-ack? Given this is int4 and might cause silent quality drops, I prefer automatic rollback on the critical thresholds and human notif for warnings.

Maya (ML): Agreed — auto-rollback enabled for critical thresholds. Human in the loop for warnings. I'll also open a short incident channel if rollback triggers.

Chris (Infra): Canary pool confirmed healthy. Going to tag nodes: `node.tag=quant-canary-2026-03-17`

Maya (ML): Kicking the flag now.

release-bot: Canary status: running, pct=5. Metric snapshot baseline attached.

Maya (ML): t+10m update — no errors, latency within baseline, small cost reduction as expected. Still monitoring quality_score closely.

Pranav: Saw one small blip in CTR at t+7m (-0.3%) but within noise.

Olga: Keep an eye — if that trend continues past 20m we escalate.

Maya (ML): Will do. If we stay green at t+30m I'll approve bump to 20% for 1h.

Pranav: Thumbs up from me. :+1:

Chris (Infra): 👍 infra good here too.

release-bot: Canary still healthy at t+30m. No auto-rollbacks.

Maya (ML): Bumping to 20% now. Updated flag: `pct=20`, meta="int4-canary-2026-03-17-step2".

Olga: Good. I'll keep the stricter alert windows for the next hour.

Maya (ML): Final note for post-mortem: collect offline evals at +1h and +6h, export sampled payloads, and record cost delta. If anything odd, we revert to fp16 and open a regression ticket.

Pranav: I'll draft the rollback playbook and add contact list (Maya/Olga/Chris) for pager escalations.

Maya (ML): Thanks everyone. Will post final outcome at t+2h.

release-bot: Canary completed: pct=20, duration=1h step passed. No rollbacks. Logged: rollout/int4-canary-2026-03-17

Maya (ML): Closing thread — successful canary, moving to staged rollout. Follow-ups: PR with perf numbers and sampled examples incoming.

Olga: Nice work.

Pranav: Great, congrats.

Chris (Infra): 🎉
